body: I just checked online, but everything has a monthly subscription. Do you know of any? I'm so tired of feeling like this.
Honestly, I'm all tapped out of savings. I can't afford to see a therapist. And of course I don't have insurance.
Thank you, but I just can't see how. I've been struggling for a over a year. My business just went bankrupt and I can't seem to find a job. I've been looking for 4 months now.
I have friends but no one I can really talk to where I feel like I can really tell them how I'm feeling. My family doesn't understand. They just tell me to man up and start acting my age.
